note: Mutants are applied to a temporary copy of src/core only. A killed mutant means the selected tests failed against the deliberate fault. This is evidence about test sensitivity, not about learning outcomes or model accuracy.

results.description: default base delay changed from 5 s to 4 s

selections.pattern: (?:^(default policy|custom policies|a paused entry is excluded))|(?:^(manual retry|repeating a manual retry|a fresh entry that never failed|after a pause))

failingTests: default policy: provider calls are exactly 5, at +5 s, +10 s, +20 s, +40 s, then the entry pauses and is never due again
a paused entry is excluded from due work and from the next-attempt clock, but still counts as needing attention
a valid ISO timestamp retains the existing bounded retry behaviour
